title: yencoding-multi: unchecked total_size cast panics on large input
description: assembler.rs:67: vec![0u8; total_size as usize] panics on OOM for adversarial large total_size. On 32-bit, silently truncates. Constructor should return Result<Self, AssemblyError> with TotalSizeTooLarge variant.
close_reason: Fixed as part of MIME-3ps.1: Assembler::new now returns Result<Self, AssemblyError::TotalSizeTooLarge>
